svg.title: Burrcap Hollow — Mushroom hollow
svg.desc: Oversized mushroom caps are readable jump surfaces around a sunken clearing. Fallen trunks and gathering baskets lead to a sheltered forager loft. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Oversized mushroom caps are readable jump surfaces around a sunken clearing. Fallen trunks
and gathering baskets lead to a sheltered forager loft.
8 raised landings · 2 stairs · 3 ropes · 3 ladders · 26 props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Thistlecap Rascal · Hostile / Common; optional local encounter.
